title: Ride to the airport
text:
Maya (8:12 AM): Hey, are you still able to drive me to the airport on Friday? My flight leaves at 2:40.

Daniel (8:20 AM): Yes, but I have a class until 11:30. I could pick you up at 11:45 at the earliest.

Maya (8:22 AM): That should work. The airline says to arrive two hours early for international flights, and it's about a 40-minute drive.

Daniel (8:25 AM): OK. Traffic can be bad around noon, though, so have your bags by the door so we can leave right away.

Maya (8:26 AM): Will do. I'll pay for parking if you want to come in and have lunch with me first.

questions.prompt: Why does Daniel ask Maya to have her bags by the door?
options: His car does not have enough space for many bags.
There is not much extra time before Maya needs to be at the airport.
He has to go back to class after the drive.
Maya often forgets to pack her bags in time.
questions.explanation: Daniel no puede salir antes de las 11:45, el trayecto dura unos 40 minutos y Maya debe llegar dos horas antes (12:40). Con poco margen y tráfico al mediodía, no pueden perder tiempo.
questions.evidence: Traffic can be bad around noon, though, so have your bags by the door so we can leave right away.
optionNotes: No se habla del tamaño del coche.
Correcta: 11:45 + 40 min = 12:25; tiene que llegar a las 12:40 (dos horas antes de las 2:40). Hay sólo 15 minutos de margen y puede haber tráfico.
Su clase termina a las 11:30, antes del viaje.
Nada indica que Maya sea olvidadiza.

questions.prompt: What does Maya offer to do?
options: Pay Daniel for the gas
Take a taxi if Daniel is late
Leave earlier in the morning
Pay for parking at the airport
questions.explanation: Maya ofrece pagar el aparcamiento si Daniel quiere entrar a comer con ella.
questions.evidence: I'll pay for parking if you want to come in and have lunch with me first.
optionNotes: No menciona la gasolina.
No menciona un taxi.
Daniel no puede antes de las 11:45.
Correcta: lo dice en su último mensaje.

title: Elevator replacement
text:
NOTICE TO RESIDENTS — Harbor View Apartments

The east elevator will be replaced beginning Monday, March 3. The work is expected to take three weeks. During this time, only the west elevator will be available, so please expect longer wait times, especially between 7:30 and 9:00 AM.

Residents who need to move large furniture during the project must reserve the west elevator at the front desk at least 48 hours in advance. Reservations are limited to two hours per apartment.

Residents with mobility difficulties who live above the fifth floor may request assistance with groceries and packages by calling the management office at 555-0182.

We apologize for the inconvenience and thank you for your patience.

To ask residents to stop moving furniture
To explain why the west elevator is broken

No se menciona personal nuevo.

title: Beginner pottery class
text:
Beginner Pottery — Saturday Mornings

Have you always wanted to make your own bowls and cups? Join our four-week beginner class at Clayworks Studio, 210 Pine Street. Classes run every Saturday from 10:00 AM to 12:00 PM, starting April 5.

The price is $120, which includes all clay, tools, and firing of your finished pieces. No experience is needed. Please wear clothes that can get dirty!

Classes are limited to eight students. To sign up, visit our website or call 555-0147.

title: Internship start date
text:
From: Priya Raman, HR Coordinator, Lindqvist Engineering
To: Tomás Ortega
Subject: Your summer internship — start date

Dear Tomás,

Thank you for returning your signed offer letter. I'm writing about a change to your start date. Because our office is moving to a new building during the first week of June, we have decided to postpone the start of all summer internships from June 2 to June 9. The internship will still end on August 15, as originally planned.

We understand that this shortens the program by a week. To make up for this, interns may choose to complete an optional online orientation during the week of June 2; those who do will be paid for 15 hours of work.

If the new date creates a serious problem for you, for example because of housing arrangements, please let me know by May 20 and we will try to find a solution.

Best regards,
Priya Raman

options: To offer him a position after his internship ends
To ask him to sign and return his offer letter
To explain a delay to his internship and the options related to it
To tell him that the internship will end later than planned
questions.explanation: El correo comunica que el inicio pasa del 2 al 9 de junio y describe la orientación opcional y la posibilidad de pedir una solución.
questions.evidence: we have decided to postpone the start of all summer internships from June 2 to June 9
optionNotes: No se habla de un puesto posterior.

Correcta: el inicio se retrasa una semana y explica la orientación opcional y qué hacer si hay problemas.

title: Park cleanup moved
text:
Oakridge Neighbors Group
Posted by Lena Fischer

Thanks to everyone who signed up for Saturday's park cleanup! The forecast now shows heavy rain on Saturday, so we're moving the event to Sunday at the same time, 9 AM. If you can't make it on Sunday, no worries — just reply here so I can update the list. The city is still providing gloves and trash bags, but we're short on rakes, so please bring one if you have one. Coffee and pastries are on me!

title: Campus Print Center FAQ
text:
Campus Print Center — Frequently Asked Questions

How much does printing cost?
Black-and-white pages cost $0.08 each, and color pages cost $0.35 each. Double-sided pages are charged as two pages.

How do I pay?
Printing is charged to your student ID card. You can add money to your card online or at any library kiosk. Cash is not accepted at the Print Center.

Can I print large posters?
Yes. Poster orders must be submitted online at least two business days before you need them. Posters are printed on weekdays only.

Where do I pick up my order?
Small orders can be collected from any campus printer. Posters must be picked up at the Print Center desk in the basement of Hale Library.

questions.evidence: Double-sided pages are charged as two pages.
optionNotes: Es el precio de 10 páginas a una cara.
Correcta: 10 hojas a doble cara = 20 páginas × $0.08 = $1.60.
Es el precio de 10 páginas en color.
Es el precio de 20 páginas en color.

Correcta: se cobra a la tarjeta de estudiante, que se recarga en línea o en un quiosco.

title: Winter ferry timetable
text:
Island Ferry — Winter Timetable (November 1 – March 31)

Departs Port Ellis: 6:45 AM* | 9:30 AM | 12:15 PM | 3:00 PM | 5:45 PM**
Departs Gull Island: 7:40 AM* | 10:30 AM | 1:15 PM | 4:00 PM | 6:40 PM**

* Weekdays only. Does not run on public holidays.
** Fridays and Saturdays only.

Crossing time is approximately 45 minutes. Vehicles must check in at least 30 minutes before departure; foot passengers, 10 minutes. Vehicle reservations are required on all sailings marked with an asterisk. During storms, sailings may be canceled with little notice; check the website before traveling.
